name: Li Kang Biomedical Co., Ltd.
summary: Li Kang Biomedical Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and distribution of nutritional supplements, cosmeceuticals, and health-focused beverages. Beyond its product lines, the company also provides consulting and operational support for tourism factories, and offers telemarketing solutions. Established in 1982, the firm initially operated under the name BAFO Technologies Corporation, before adopting its current moniker, Li Kang Biomedical Co., Ltd., in September 2014. The company maintains its headquarters in Tainan City, Taiwan.
